terms_evidence.release: Official README-E3 states public domain/public release, as-is and without warranty; files are externally hosted due to size.

deterministic_selection.candidate_unit: performer + official good topic + engagement run + host + contiguous window start
deterministic_selection.topic_order: Sort official good topic names by UTF-8 byte order and choose the first per performer; do not substitute an unlisted topic.
deterministic_selection.window_rule: For each selected topic, select the earliest complete contiguous 3600-second benign window and earliest complete contiguous 3600-second window intersecting a documented ground-truth activity interval; keep each performer/topic/host/run/window indivisible.
deterministic_selection.group_boundary: No Avro event, host, or overlapping window is split across partitions.
deterministic_selection.selection_failure: Missing good topic, complete window, host/run identity, ground-truth alignment, or valid record causes a stop and REQUEST_SMALLER_OR_DIFFERENT_SUBSET.

expected_provider_object_identity.expected_identity_rule: The acquisition operator must record provider object ID, exact path/name, provider revision/ETag if available, byte length, and topic/performer for every selected object and the ground-truth artifact. Nulls are intentional until a human-approved manifest is created.

checksum_and_size.checksum_method: Hash exact provider bytes before decoding and every extracted Avro/JSON/PDF/schema file; hash canonical ordered manifest JSON with sorted keys/compact separators; retain provider IDs and byte lengths.

size_caps.overflow_action: Stop transfer and request a smaller/different subset; no silent truncation.

cdm_and_parser_expectations.schema: Decode the official Avro/CDM records with the pinned schema/parser identity and preserve performer/topic/source IDs in metadata only.

label_expectations.availability: Expected from official E3 ground-truth/ACT documentation; exact provider object identity and checksum are unknown until approved manifesting.

roles.ground_truth_overlap_window: positive only where independent ground-truth alignment says so; remaining background is not relabeled by proximity
roles.calibration: groups assigned by the frozen R5 hash split, never formal material

label_expectations.label_quality_gate: Every positive label cites the ground-truth artifact/interval, performer/topic/host/run, source record identity, and alignment method; ambiguous or incomplete joins quarantine the entire group.
label_expectations.encoder_boundary: No ground-truth field, ACT annotation, topic/performer ID, engagement schedule, action identity, or outcome enters x.

rules: Map process, file, socket/system-component entities and causal interactions into the R3 canonical entity/event contract.
Version each performer-specific mapping and retain unknown/invalid counters; never silently coerce invalid Avro/CDM records.
Normalize timestamps to UTC epoch milliseconds and persist deterministic node_map, edge_map, and normalization_map.
De-identify host/path/user identifiers before split assignment; source IDs, topic IDs, and mapping keys are metadata only.
Ground-truth joins occur after feature construction or in a separate target channel; they cannot influence x.
Persist raw/normalized/graph/feature hashes and finite x [N,32]/edge_index [2,E] checks.

stop_conditions: any provider object ID, exact path, schema/parser identity, or checksum remains null at transfer/decode time
a selected topic is not on the official good-topic list
selection criteria cannot be satisfied without post-hoc relaxation
per-object/extracted checksum mismatch or partial transfer
10 GiB compressed or 30 GiB expanded cap is exceeded
ground-truth alignment is missing or ambiguous
CDM schema/parser cannot be pinned and reproduced
FA1B2de/1796-action overlap or Track O metadata is detected
normalization cannot produce finite 32D features with complete audit counters
